comment: The programs the setup needs besides this kit's own files. Each is looked for in the 'downloads' folder first; the online edition downloads what is missing, the offline edition ships them. A download is used only if its SHA-256 matches. The decomp is not hashed as one file (GitHub's zip is not byte-stable): its files are checked one by one against app/port/decomp-manifest.txt.

toolchain.title: Compiler and Python (llvm-mingw 20240619: clang 18.1.8, lld, mingw-w64 headers and libraries, Python 3.11)
toolchain.map_comment: In the Windows zip the C headers sit in include\ at the top (the Linux package links i686-w64-mingw32/include to them). The build wants them in <sysroot>/include, so they are unpacked there; the C++ library headers are not needed.
toolchain.licence: Apache-2.0 with LLVM exception (LLVM), ZPL/public domain/BSD (mingw-w64), PSF (Python). Their licence texts are inside the zip.

decomp.title: The game's source code (the kyujo decompilation, pinned commit)
